title: Go with Renzo for this tour.
text:
Renzo shared his passion for Barcelona!
It made it a great experience for us while learning about Barcelona.
author: Julia_B

title: Barcelona Tuk Tuk
text:
Excellent overview of Barcelona, our driver Peter was very safe and provided a good commentary 
Thank you
author: John_T

title: A fabulous way to see the sights of Barcelona
text: What a fabulous way to see the city! Renzo our guide/ driver was so friendly and shared a wealth of information with us as we saw all of the key sights of Barcelona. With photo stop opportunities and a very special ride around the beautiful streets. Best experience of our whole holiday.
author: Jane_S

title: Five star experience all...
text: FIVE STAR EXPERIENCE ALL AROUND! DEF DON'T MISS THIS !! It's like having your own private tour of the city - great way to see it all!
author: williamcharlesadams

title: Very personal tour with...
text: Very personal tour with the best tour guide making the most out of a closed down city due to a bike marathon.
author: Lisa_P

title: Tuk tuk review
text: Highly recommend this company!! So informative. Carlos was so fun and very knowledgeable.  You will enjoy this and you don’t have to walk unless you want to get off for some views..
author: Brett_A
